purpose: Temporary hats supplied by the game's owner to build and test the equipment appearance system. Not production art: their look, style and resolution are not final, and no production licensing or approval is sought for them.
source: art/placeholder/hats/sheet_1.jpg to sheet_4.jpg (the owner's magenta sheets, six hats each).
replacement: Final hats come from the owner's own Blender 5.2 pipeline and replace these under the same appearance ids (client/data/appearances.json -> placeholder_art.json asset entries); item ids, appearance ids, equipment slots and saves do not change.
